description: Generic Treble/GSI readiness gates for elizaOS on a third-party Android device, evaluated by scripts/android/device-qualify.ts from read-only adb/fastboot observations. Product thresholds (RAM, storage, display, cameras, radios, codecs) belong in a product requirements file passed with --requirements. A pass is observation evidence only: it is not a GSI boot, hardware-target admission (android/hardware-targets.json) or user acceptance.

requirements.rationale: A GSI-style system image needs a Treble vendor interface.
Android 13 or newer vendor interface. Confirm against the framework compatibility matrix of the pinned AOSP release before relying on it.
Oldest GKI branch (android12-5.10) still in current framework support windows.
Keeps an upgrade path as 5.10 leaves the support window.
elizaOS device images and native agent payloads target ARM64.
GSI flashing writes logical partitions through fastbootd.

fastbootRequirements.rationale: Installing a GSI requires an unlockable bootloader.
Relock with the release verified-boot key (android/signing). Without it the device stays unlocked unless the ODM fuses a key.
